title: Google Android Shutdown

title: The First Computer Bug
description: The term 'bug' in computer science was popularized when a real moth was found trapped in a relay of the Harvard Mark II computer in 1947.

title: Claude Origins

title: Solid-State Battery Breakthroughs

title: Apple Acquires Hologram Inc.
description: Apple has just confirmed the acquisition of Hologram Inc., a secretive startup building holographic smartphones, for a record-breaking $50 billion.
